mapper.sql: k.id, k.user_id AS userId, k.key_name AS keyName, k.key_prefix AS keyPrefix, k.secret_hash AS secretHash, k.create_time AS createTime, k.last_used_time AS lastUsedTime, u.username, u.role, u.account_type AS accountType, u.password_login_enabled AS passwordLoginEnabled
mapper.select: SELECT FROM api_access_key k JOIN app_user u ON trim(u.id)=trim(k.user_id) WHERE k.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM api_access_key k JOIN app_user u ON trim(u.id)=trim(k.user_id) WHERE k.key_prefix=#{keyPrefix}
SELECT FROM api_access_key k JOIN app_user u ON trim(u.id)=trim(k.user_id) ORDER BY k.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_access_key (id, user_id, key_name, key_prefix, secret_hash, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{keyName}, #{keyPrefix}, #{secretHash}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_access_key SET last_used_time=#{lastUsedTime} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE app_user SET role=#{role} WHERE trim(id)=#{userId} AND account_type = 'API'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM app_user WHERE trim(id)=#{userId} AND account_type = 'API'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM app_user WHERE trim(id)=#{userId} AND account_type = 'API')
SELECT password_login_enabled FROM app_user WHERE trim(id)=#{userId}
